LAB-6331d55288.summary: Tightly couples GNSS with visual-inertial measurements for localization.

LAB-8003fe1fbd.sourceTitle: DiffPoseNet: Direct Differentiable Camera Pose Estimation

LAB-829d5dd0c5.summary: Reexamines visual geolocalization approaches for large-scale applications.

LAB-829d5dd0c5.sourceTitle: Rethinking Visual Geo-localization for Large-Scale Applications

LAB-dd5d78b92b.summary: Uses a Transformer for cross-view image geolocalization.
LAB-dd5d78b92b.sourceSummary: Transformer를 이용해 서로 다른 시점의 영상에서 지리적 위치를 추정한다.
LAB-dd5d78b92b.sourceTitle: TransGeo: Transformer Is All You Need for Cross-view Image Geo-localization

nice-slam.summary: Combines hierarchical grids and neural implicit representations to model scene geometry in dense visual SLAM.

nice-slam.sourceTitle: NICE-SLAM: Neural Implicit Scalable Encoding for SLAM

LAB-ed7ed878f0.summary: Learns cross-modal maps for vision-language navigation.
LAB-ed7ed878f0.sourceSummary: Vision-language navigation을 위한 cross-modal map을 학습한다.
LAB-ed7ed878f0.sourceTitle: Cross-Modal Map Learning for Vision and Language Navigation

LAB-f09aaaa5d3.summary: Learns to detect scene landmarks for camera localization.
LAB-f09aaaa5d3.sourceSummary: 카메라 위치 추정에 사용할 장면 landmark의 탐지를 학습한다.
LAB-f09aaaa5d3.sourceTitle: Learning to Detect Scene Landmarks for Camera Localization

LAB-25f6de1704.summary: Applies style transfer to reconstructed indoor 3D scenes.
LAB-25f6de1704.sourceSummary: 실내 3D 장면 복원 결과에 style transfer를 적용한다.
LAB-25f6de1704.sourceTitle: StyleMesh: Style Transfer for Indoor 3D Scene Reconstructions

LAB-0634ecdc06.summary: Builds anti-aliased neural radiance fields for unbounded scenes.
LAB-0634ecdc06.sourceSummary: 경계가 정해지지 않은 장면에서 aliasing을 줄이는 neural radiance field를 구성한다.
LAB-0634ecdc06.sourceTitle: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields

LAB-e917bbeb7d.summary: Uses neural bipartite graph matching for multi-robot active mapping.

LAB-7f105320b0.sourceTitle: Efficient Large-scale Localization by Global Instance Recognition

LAB-4d9025ef47.summary: Examines whether mapping is necessary for realistic PointGoal navigation.

dust3r.summary: Predicts point maps from image pairs without known camera calibration or poses, then aligns the pairs in a shared coordinate frame.

splatam.summary: Tracks the RGB-D camera and updates a 3D Gaussian map, using silhouette masks to distinguish mapped regions from newly observed areas.
splatam.sourceSummary: RGB-D 영상으로 3D Gaussian 지도를 갱신하고 카메라를 추적하며, silhouette mask로 관측된 영역과 새로 추가할 영역을 구분한다.
splatam.sourceTitle: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM

monogs.summary: Uses rendering and direct optimization of 3D Gaussians for camera tracking and mapping.
monogs.sourceSummary: 3D Gaussian 표현을 이용한 렌더링과 직접 최적화를 카메라 tracking 및 mapping에 함께 사용한다.

gs-slam.summary: Expands and prunes a 3D Gaussian map and selects reliable Gaussians for coarse-to-fine pose estimation.
gs-slam.sourceSummary: 3D Gaussian 지도를 확장·정리하고, coarse-to-fine pose 추정에서 신뢰할 수 있는 Gaussian을 선택한다.
gs-slam.sourceTitle: GS-SLAM: Dense Visual SLAM with 3D Gaussian Splatting

photo-slam.summary: Combines geometric localization with photometric representation learning, using Gaussian-pyramid learning to progressively represent image detail.
photo-slam.sourceSummary: 기하 특징을 이용한 localization과 photometric 표현 학습을 결합하고, Gaussian pyramid 학습으로 지도의 영상 세부 정보를 점진적으로 표현한다.
photo-slam.sourceTitle: Photo-SLAM: Real-time Simultaneous Localization and Photorealistic Mapping for Monocular, Stereo, and RGB-D Cameras

3dgs.summary: Optimizes Gaussian positions, covariances, and appearance from sparse SfM points, with density control and splatting for novel-view rendering.
3dgs.sourceSummary: SfM으로 얻은 희소 점에서 출발해 Gaussian의 위치·공분산·appearance를 최적화하고, 밀도 조절과 splatting으로 새로운 시점의 영상을 렌더링한다.
3dgs.sourceTitle: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering

add-vggt-2025.summary: Uses a feed-forward Transformer to jointly predict camera parameters, point maps, depth maps, and 3D point tracks from images.

add-mast3r-2024.summary: Adds a local-feature head and matching loss to DUSt3R point-map prediction to connect image matching with 3D reconstruction.
add-mast3r-2024.sourceSummary: DUSt3R의 point map 예측에 local feature head와 matching loss를 추가해 영상 대응점 추정을 3D 재구성과 연결한다.
add-mast3r-2024.sourceTitle: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R

add-mast3r-slam-2025.summary: Uses MASt3R pairwise 3D priors for point-map matching, camera tracking, map fusion, loop closure, and global optimization in dense monocular SLAM.
add-mast3r-slam-2025.sourceSummary: MASt3R의 두 영상 3D prior를 point map matching, 카메라 추적, 지도 융합, loop closure와 전역 최적화에 사용하는 단안 dense SLAM을 제안한다.
add-mast3r-slam-2025.sourceTitle: MASt3R-SLAM: Real-Time Dense SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors

add-pings-2025.summary: Combines signed distance fields and Gaussian radiance fields within a point-based implicit neural map for LiDAR-visual SLAM.
add-pings-2025.sourceSummary: Point-based implicit neural map 안에서 signed distance field와 Gaussian radiance field를 결합하는 LiDAR-visual SLAM을 제안한다.
add-pings-2025.sourceTitle: PINGS: Gaussian Splatting Meets Distance Fields within a Point-Based Implicit Neural Map

add-dg-slam-2024.summary: Combines motion masks, Gaussian management, and hybrid camera tracking for Gaussian SLAM in dynamic scenes.
add-dg-slam-2024.sourceSummary: 동적 장면에서 motion mask, Gaussian 관리와 hybrid camera tracking을 결합하는 Gaussian SLAM을 제안한다.
add-dg-slam-2024.sourceTitle: DG-SLAM: Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Hybrid Pose Optimization

add-openvo-2026.summary: Uses temporal information and 3D priors to estimate ego-motion from monocular driving videos with varying capture intervals and camera calibration.
add-openvo-2026.sourceSummary: 촬영 간격과 카메라 보정 정보가 일정하지 않은 단안 주행 영상에서 시간 정보와 3D prior를 활용해 ego-motion을 추정한다.
add-openvo-2026.sourceTitle: OpenVO: Open-World Visual Odometry with Temporal Dynamics Awareness

add-aergs-slam-2026.summary: Separates illumination-robust localization from exposure-modeled Gaussian mapping for stereo images with automatic exposure changes.
add-aergs-slam-2026.sourceSummary: 자동 노출 변화가 있는 stereo 영상에서 조명 변화에 대응하는 localization과 exposure model을 이용한 Gaussian mapping을 분리해 구성한다.
add-aergs-slam-2026.sourceTitle: AERGS-SLAM: Auto-Exposure-Robust Stereo 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM

add-vggt-slam2-2026.summary: Redesigns the factor graph for VGGT submap alignment and uses VGGT attention to verify loop closures in RGB SLAM.
add-vggt-slam2-2026.sourceSummary: VGGT submap 정합을 위한 factor graph를 재설계하고 VGGT attention을 loop closure 검증에 활용하는 RGB SLAM을 제안한다.
add-vggt-slam2-2026.sourceTitle: VGGT-SLAM 2.0: Real-time Dense Feed-forward Scene Reconstruction

add-bievr-lio-2026.summary: Represents voxel surfaces with oriented height images and selects geometrically informative regions for LiDAR-inertial registration.

add-bievr-lio-2026.sourceTitle: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps

add-anyfeature-vslam-2024.summary: Automates feature-parameter adjustment when integrating different keypoints and descriptors into ORB-SLAM2.

add-wildgs-slam-2025.summary: Uses uncertainty maps predicted from DINOv2 features for tracking and Gaussian-map optimization in dynamic monocular SLAM.

add-vggt-slam-2025.summary: Aligns VGGT submaps from uncalibrated monocular images through SL(4) optimization with loop-closure constraints.
add-vggt-slam-2025.sourceSummary: Uncalibrated 단안 영상으로 만든 VGGT submap을 SL(4) 위의 최적화로 정합하고 loop closure를 반영한다.
add-vggt-slam-2025.sourceTitle: VGGT-SLAM: Dense RGB SLAM Optimized on the SL(4) Manifold

add-slam-former-2026.summary: Alternates incremental monocular tracking and mapping with global refinement within a single Transformer.

add-cg-slam-2024.summary: Uses a geometrically consistent 3D Gaussian field with depth uncertainty for RGB-D tracking and mapping.

add-sgs-slam-2024.summary: Jointly optimizes appearance, geometry, and semantic features and uses semantics for keyframe selection in Gaussian SLAM.

vision-cfccf944e5.sourceTitle: Reloc3r: Large-Scale Training of Relative Camera Pose Regression for Generalizable, Fast, and Accurate Visual Localization
